title: UneceTransportServiceLocation
description: A location where a transport service takes place.

identifier.description:
An identifier for this transport service location, such as a United Nations Location Code (UNLOCODE) or GS1 Global
Location Number (GLN).

locationFunctionTypeCode.description: A code specifying the type of transport service location.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, of this transport service location.

physicalGeographicalCoordinate.description: Geographical coordinate information for this physical transport service location.
